Overview

Nantes is a city in Pays de la Loire with a population of 314,000. A dynamic city on the Loire River with a creative arts scene, medieval castle, and excellent quality of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
